title: The Orphans plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all…
description: The Orphans WordPress plugin up to version 3.4.5 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'comment' parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts. Exploitation requires a two-step comment approval process leveraging WordPress's comment_previously_approved mechanism to auto-publish the attacker's payload without moderation.
